# Actor builds

The API endpoints in this section allow you to manage your Apify Actors builds.

<!-- -->

## [Get list of builds](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-builds-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/builds](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-builds-get.md)

## [Build Actor](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-builds-post.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/builds](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-builds-post.md)

## [Get default build](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-build-default-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/builds/default](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-build-default-get.md)

## [Get OpenAPI definition](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-openapi-json-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/builds/{buildId}/openapi.json](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-openapi-json-get.md)

## [Get build](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-build-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/builds/{buildId}](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-build-get.md)

## [Abort build](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-build-abort-post.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/builds/{buildId}/abort](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actors-build-abort-post.md)
